message: Last week, we had a surprise blackout just as I was settling in for a cozy movie night. I reached for my trusty power bank to keep my phone charged, and it felt like a small victory! I also dug out my favorite lantern to light up the living room, turning the darkness into a little adventure. It reminded me that being prepared can bring some unexpected joy, even in a hiccup. How do you keep the good vibes going during a power outage?
